g.text: Synthetic data: 36 000 folded signals (40 % planets, 35 % eclipsing binaries with V shapes, secondary eclipses or odd–even differences, 25 % artefacts), SNR 6–40.
Network: 262 inputs (201-bin global and 61-bin local views), two ReLU layers (64, 32), dropout, Adam; trained on 24 000, tested on 8 000. Seed 510.
